dedupe_keys.name: shovels nationwide building permit and contractor database us

description: Shovels is a commercial service that collects building permits from US jurisdictions and links them to contractors, inspections and properties, offered through a no-code web application (Shovels Online), an API, a GIS product and enterprise data licences. Users can search nationwide permits by address, city, state, contractor, permit type and project value, find contractors by specialty, location, licence or performance, and analyse permit volumes and approval times; the coverage dashboard maps permit volume by state and county. Pricing when read: a free tier with downloadable records, one year of history, one seat and 500 credits a month, and a Basic plan at 599 US dollars a month with full history and 25,000 credits, with higher tiers on request. Coverage: US jurisdictions, with coverage varying by county. Access: sign-up; free tier limited. Licence: commercial terms. Caveats: coverage and field consistency depend on what each jurisdiction publishes, and the normalisation methods are proprietary. Simulation uses: national tracking of construction, retrofit and electrification permits (such as solar, heat pump or EV charger installs) for stock turnover and grid models. Related records: the Census Building Permits Survey, Austin issued construction permits and San Diego development permits.
